shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,280p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && git log -3 --oneline && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && cat package.json | sed -n '1,160p' && cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\" && rg \"interface ErrorObject|dataPath|instancePath|interface Options\" node_modules/ajv/lib node_modules/ajv/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -80 && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,130p' && git branch --show-current"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npm ls ajv @types/ajv && cat tsconfig.json && cat node_modules/ajv/package.json | sed -n '1,90p' && rg 'declare module .ajv.|interface Options' src node_modules/@types -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts && rg 'declare class Ajv|export default' node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts && rg '\"ajv\"' package-lock.json | head -10 && git show HEAD"'^:src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts | sed -n '"'1,90p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "ls node_modules/@types/ajv 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -f node_modules/@types/ajv/index.d.ts ]; then sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@types/ajv/index.d.ts; fi; rg 'interface ErrorObject' node_modules -g '*.d.ts' | head -20"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat jest.config.js && node --input-type=module -e \"import Ajv from 'ajv'; const a=new Ajv(); const v=a.compile({type:'object',properties:{x:{type:'string'}}}); v({x:1}); console.log(Ajv.version, v.errors)\" && node -p \"require.resolve('ajv')\" && git show --stat --oneline HEAD"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,125p'; test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; echo reanchor_exists:"'$?'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "Handle AJV validation paths compatibly" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
